claims.title: Compile small rational identities into integer multiplication and retain the typed packing obstructions

The compiler requires a verified rational v-by-v bilinear identity of rank r<v^(2+delta/2), or the existence premise omega_Q=2. Homogeneous packing uses R_t=Q[x_0,...,x_d]_t, shared IDENTITY left input, full products P_(a,b) and their right/output duals, and the supplied two-round criterion.
